other_conditions: Applicant must be registered under PM Kisan Samman Nidhi Yojana.
Applicant must own cultivable land on which they are farming.
Applicants who are former or present holders of constitutional posts, ministers, members of Parliament, state legislators, mayors, or district panchayat chairpersons are not eligible.

Serving or retired officers and employees of central or state government ministries, departments, PSEs, attached offices, autonomous institutions, and regular employees of local bodies (excluding multi‑tasking staff/Class IV/Group D) are not eligible.
Retired pensioners whose monthly pension is Rs 10,000 or more are not eligible.
Persons who paid income tax in the last assessment year are not eligible.
Professionals such as doctors, engineers, lawyers, chartered accountants, and architects registered with professional bodies are not eligible.
Applicant must be a poor farmer.
benefits_summary: Eligible farmers receive Rs 4,000 per year, paid in two installments of Rs 2,000 each.
